key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset
key.description: Redeem a banked reset automatically within 1 hour of expiry

key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset-on-usage
key.summary: Auto-redeem when remaining usage is low
key.description: Redeem the banked reset nearest to expiry when any active limit falls below the percentage remaining threshold. Check only after successful usage refreshes at the normal cadence, never from cached usage.

key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset-usage-window
key.description: Usage window ID to check for automatic banked reset redemption, or any to check all active windows

key.name: auto-apply-banked-reset-usage-threshold
key.description: Percentage remaining below which any active limit triggers automatic banked reset redemption when enabled
